shortDescription: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 27, 2026) - PesoRama Inc. TSXV:PESO (OTCQX: PSSOF) (FSE: ZE6) ("PesoRama" or the "Company"), a Canadian company operating 49 dollar stores in Mexico under the JOi Dollar Plus brand, today announced that it will be presenting at the Planet MicroCap Toronto…

children: a Canadian company operating 49 dollar stores in Mexico under the JOi Dollar Plus brand, today announced that it will be presenting at the Planet MicroCap Toronto 2026 Powered by MicroCapClub on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 8:30 AM EST Toronto local time at the Arcadian Court & Loft in Toronto. Rahim Bhaloo, Founder, CEO and Chairman alongside Eduardo Fernandez, CFO of PesoRama Inc. will be hosting the presentation and answering questions at the conclusion.
To access the live presentation, please use the following information:
Planet MicroCap Toronto 2026 Powered by MicroCapClub

Planet Microcap hosts the highest quality microcap in-person events in North America. The mission is to bring the best microcap investors, companies, and allocators together to gather, connect, and grow. For more information about Planet MicroCap, please visit: https://planetmicrocap.com/

MicroCapClub is an exclusive forum for experienced microcap investors to share and discuss microcap companies (sub $1 billion market cap) trading on global markets. Since 2011, our members have profiled 1500+ microcap companies, 300+ have turned into multi-baggers. Investors can join our community by applying to become a member or subscribing to gain instant access. For more information, visit https://planetmicrocap.com/

PesoRama, operating under the JOi Dollar Plus brand, is a Mexican value dollar store retailer. PesoRama launched operations in 2019 in Mexico City and the surrounding areas targeting high density, high traffic locations. PesoRama's 49 stores (soon to be 54) offer consistent merchandise offerings which include items in the following categories: household goods, pet supplies, seasonal products, party supplies, health and beauty, snack food items, confectionery and more. For more information visit: http://pesorama.ca
